Microsoft Graph List chats

params.name: $top
params.description: Show only the first n items

items.docs: Retrieve the list of chats that the user is part of. This method supports federation. When a user ID is provided, the calling application must belong to the same tenant that the user belongs to.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke function delta

params.name: $top
params.description: Show only the first n items

items.docs: Get the list of messages from all chats in which a user is a participant, including one-on-one chats, group chats, and meeting chats. When you use delta query, you can get new or updated messages. To get the replies for a message, use the list message replies or the get message reply operations. A GET request with the delta function returns one of the following: State tokens are opaque to the client. To proceed with a round of change tracking, copy and apply the @odata.nextLink or @odata.deltaLi
